items:
Welcome to “The Innlet”, a newly constructed 3 story home conveniently tucked away in Inlet Beach, FL. This beautiful 3 Bedroom/ 3.5 Bath / Bunk Room and Loft provides sleeping spaces for 10 comfortably. This home is only 0.5 miles from the beach and minutes from all that 30A has to offer. Visit nearby Rosemary and Alys Beach, spend your sun-filled days at the Inlet Beach Regional Public Beach Access (the largest public beach access in South Walton), or enjoy Camp Helen State Park with its array of trails. Guests of “The Innlet” can travel easily by bike to the Donut Hole and shopping (and other dining options) at the newly developed 30Avenue shopping center.

As you enter the home on the main level, you will find a beautifully decorated living room, kitchen, and dining room with 11 ft ceilings and plenty of space for you and your family. The kitchen is stocked with gas stove, oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, and dining seating for 9. Our back patio comes with seating for seven accompanied by a TV for your viewing pleasure. The garage serves as a perfect place to gear up for any adventure you have planned and is stocked with 6 Tommy Bahama backpack beach chairs, 2 umbrellas, and 4 white beach cruiser bikes.

The second floor boasts three bedrooms. The owner’s suite is accompanied by a king-sized bed, beautiful en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower, vanity for two, toilet, and private walk-in closet. The remaining bedrooms on this floor share a full bathroom and each offer a queen size bed. A full-sized washer and dryer are conveniently located to these bedrooms.

The third floor offers a spacious secondary living space in the loft perfect for entertaining. In this space you will find two sofas (one sleeper sofa), two chairs, and a 65-inch television. As you continue down the hallway, you will find a full bathroom along with a bunk room fit to sleep two.

Our goal is to provide you with a clean, comfortable getaway filled with plenty of Florida sunshine, fun, and wonderful memories. We want to ensure that you feel right at home and are committed to be available during your stay should you need any assistance or have questions at all. Our hope is that this retreat provides you time away to recharge, relax, and surround yourself with the things that matter most in life… your family and friends. We believe that “The Innlet” is the perfect place for your vacation and can’t wait to introduce you to all the beauty that 30A and the surrounding areas have to offer!

THE HOUSE:

First Level –
• Driveway Parking for two vehicles (street/yard parking is prohibited)
• Mini Garage
• Covered Front Porch
• Half Bath
• Living Room
• Kitchen / Dining Area
• Covered Back Patio with Seating and TV

Second Level –
• Primary Suite with King Bed, Walk-in Shower & Walk-in Closet
• Bedroom Two features a Queen Bed
• Bedroom Three features a Queen Bed
• Laundry Closet
• Full Bath with tub/shower combo

Third Level –
• Loft with (1) Queen Sleeper Sofa
• Seating and Entertainment Area
• Bunk Room
• Full Bath with tub/shower combo

Home Highlights –
• (6) Chairs and (2) Umbrellas
• (4) Beach Cruiser Bikes
• (4) TV’s – Back Patio, Living Room, Primary Suite, and Loft all suited with YouTube TV for your enjoyment
• Washer and Dryer
• WIFI
• Driveway parking for two vehicles
• Fully appointed kitchen- Ninja blender, toaster, hand mixer, Keurig & standard coffee maker

FAQ’s –
• Distance to the Beach: 0.5 Miles to the Inlet Beach Public Beach Access and in close proximity to several other public access points
• Distance to 30A: 1.2 Miles to Rosemary Beach
• Distance to West End of Panama City Beach/Pier Park: 10 miles
• Distance to Grocery: 2 Miles to Publix and Winn-Dixie
• Pets: Not Allowed
• Smoking: Not Allowed
• Community Pool

For more information, pictures, and our story visit www.theinnletvacation.com or follow us on Instagram at @theinnletvacation and Facebook.com/TheInnletVacation
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
